expectations.text: Recommends dropping the reflexive per-folder and big aggregator barrels in favour of direct path imports
expectations.evidence: 'I'd drop the per-folder index.ts barrels and the big src/components/index.ts, and switch to direct imports like import { Button } from "@/components/Button"'

expectations.text: Grounds it in agent indirection: the barrel hides where a symbol lives, so the agent hops or guesses the shape
expectations.evidence: 'the import has lost its address... it guesses the component's shape and props and edits confidently wrong'

expectations.text: Keeps a deliberate barrel only at a real public-API / package boundary (does NOT say delete all barrels)
expectations.evidence: 'Keep exactly one curated barrel only if you have a real package boundary (e.g. a shared UI lib)'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete secondary cost (circular imports, tree-shaking, or slow build/test startup)
expectations.evidence: Lists circular imports, broken tree-shaking, and slow dev-server/test startup
